size.value: Source states: 'The photo size must be 60mm width by 40mm height (6x4 cm).' (i.e. width 6cm > height 4cm, as literally published)

head_height.value: Face height should be approximately 32-36mm (photo should not be too close to the head or too far)

face_visibility.value: The entire face and part or all of the shoulders must be visible

face_visibility.en: The entire face and part or all of the shoulders must be visible.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴 전체와 어깨의 일부 또는 전체가 보여야 합니다.
face_visibility.ja: 顔全体と肩の一部または全体が写っている必要があります。

db_conflicts.research_value: Embassy of the Republic of Yemen (The Hague) states verbatim: '60mm width by 40mm height (6x4 cm)' — i.e. width(6cm) is greater than height(4cm), the reverse portrait orientation implied by DB's '4 × 6cm'. Confirmed face-height of 32-36mm fits much more naturally within a 60mm-tall frame than a 40mm-tall one, so this may be a labelling error on the embassy's own site, but is reported exactly as published rather than silently corrected.

cross_verification.note_en: Directly fetched (browser get_page_text + screenshot) from the Embassy of the Republic of Yemen in The Hague, Netherlands, official 'Photo Requirements for Passport Issuance' page. Head/face height (32-36mm = 3.2-3.6cm) matches DB's headHeight exactly. Background (plain white) matches DB. Only the width/height orientation of the size figure conflicts with DB, as detailed above.
